formattedAddress: 108, Taiwan, Taipei City, Wanhua District, Fumin Village, Section 1, Xiyuan Rd, 145號號店坊B2樓-7

displayName.text: 遊霂食光 MuMu Land | 親子友善 | 健康餐點 | 外送便當

text.text:
Great kid friendly, family friendly, cosy cafe.  Large kids play area and kids meals.  Food is healthy and delicious.  They even helped with small adjustments to the meal for my baby’s diet.

We visited a few times during our visit to Taipei.

Located on the bottom floor of the underground mall near the escalator.

text.text:
I ordered two meat dishes for NT$150 today, no set meal included, cash payment, and this shop doesn't issue uniform invoices.

For a healthy meal at NT$150, the protein content was a bit low in my opinion. Luckily, the starch content was just right. After finishing my meal, I went to the FamilyMart across from the MRT station for a can of unsweetened soy milk 😅

However, in terms of taste, it was the best side dish and main course I've ever had. The seasoning was excellent. The meat was very tender and not dry, and the vegetables were flavorful but not too salty. It was so delicious that I drank every last drop of the broth (or was it because the portion was small and I was hungry!?).

Overall, I give it 4 stars!

Also, it's the first shop after turning the corner from the MRT station towards the underground shopping mall, so it's quite easy to find! Bonus!

A shop that people will like. The staff are cool and not overly enthusiastic, which is perfect for someone like me who just wants a quiet meal!

The dining environment is comfortable, the seats are spacious, and there's water available – all pluses!

originalText.text:
今天點雙肉150沒有加套餐、現金交易、這間店是免開統一發票的。

以健康餐150元價位的蛋白質含量來說，個人覺得稍微偏少。還好他澱粉給的還算適中，我用餐完畢後，再去捷運站對面的全家補喝一罐無糖豆漿😅

但就口感來說，是我目前吃過副菜與主菜，調味都好好吃。肉處理很嫩不柴，菜的調味是有味道但又不過鹹，好吃到我菜湯湯汁喝光光（還是是份量偏少還餓所以喝光光！？）

整體我給4分！

另外
捷運站出站拐個彎往地下街方向第一家就是，算是蠻好找！加分！
I人會喜歡的店，店員酷酷不太主動熱情，對我只想安靜吃飯好適合！
用餐環境舒適，座位也很寬敞，還有水可以喝，都是加分項目！

text.text:
It was absolutely delicious!

The pork and chicken were amazing; they were so tender, unlike anything I've had elsewhere. There was absolutely no dryness, and you could tell they were prepared with great care. The pork was juicy and delicate, and the chicken was tender yet retained its natural sweetness. The sauce was perfect, not overpowering at all.

The side dishes were refreshing and naturally seasoned. The whole bowl was very filling without feeling heavy. It's the kind of restaurant you'll remember and definitely want to come back to.

originalText.text:
真的非常好吃！
豬肉和雞肉的口感讓人很驚豔，軟嫩到不像在外面吃到的那種，完全沒有乾柴感，吃得出來處理得很用心。豬肉多汁細緻，雞肉柔嫩又保有肉甜，搭配醬汁剛剛好，不會搶味。

配菜清爽、調味自然，整碗吃完很有飽足感但不會覺得負擔。是那種吃完會默默記住、下次一定會再來的店。

text.text:
Located within the Longshan Cultural and Creative Park, from Longshan Temple MRT Station towards Exit 1, there's a staircase next to it leading to the park. Walk down the stairs and through the exhibition corridor, and you'll find the shop.

This is a very thoughtfully designed healthy meal box restaurant. So far, the dishes I've tried—sous-feuille chicken breast, boiled pork foreleg, vegetarian meals, and the mixed meat platter—have all been excellent. The meats are very well prepared; the chicken breast is tender, the pork foreleg is springy, and the king oyster mushrooms in the vegetarian meal are also delicious.

The dining environment looks nice; it seems to be a family-friendly place, as there's even a children's play area.

originalText.text:
位於龍山文創基地內，從龍山寺捷運站往1號出口方向，旁邊有往文創基地的樓梯，走下去經過展覽的長廊後即可看到店家。
很用心的健康餐盒飲食店，目前吃過的餐點：舒肥雞胸、水煮豬前腿、素食餐、雙拼肉肉等，都沒有踩過地雷，肉類食材處理得很好，雞胸軟嫩、豬前腿肉有彈性，素食餐的杏鮑菇也非常好吃。
店內用餐環境看起來也不錯，應該是親子友善店家，店內還有兒童遊戲區。
